# Norn

> Norn is the coordination language for teams of people and AI agents. A Norn program asks, waits, decides and hands work over. Every request ends in an outcome (Done, Declined, Failed, TimedOut, Cancelled or Revoked), and the type checker makes the program handle each one. Status: a design draft with a local reference implementation (parser, type checker, durable evaluator, simulated host). No production host runs it yet.

The syntax is ReScript. Participants are values like `@alice`; deadlines are `~until=1h` or a time; facts and streams come from the host. Check a program with `norn check --json file.norn`.

## Writing Norn

- [Skill: writing Norn](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/norn-lang/norn/main/skills/norn/SKILL.md): the model, the built-ins, the checker's diagnostic codes and how to fix them, and five patterns
- [Examples](https://github.com/norn-lang/norn/tree/main/examples): a decision with a default, a follow-up with a handover, a release chain, a standing duty, and a "keep going until done" loop
- [Standard library](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/norn-lang/norn/main/std/std.norn): `remind`, `decide`, `followUp`, `schedule` and `digest`, written in Norn
- [Reference host interface](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/norn-lang/norn/main/hosts/reference.norn): the facts, streams and types that programs can use with the reference host

## Reference

- [Language spec](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/norn-lang/norn/main/docs/spec.md): what Norn is, its syntax, effects, standard library, safety rules and runtime protocol
- [Types](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/norn-lang/norn/main/docs/types.md): inference, built-in signatures, exhaustiveness, the no-dropped-outcomes rule, host interfaces and diagnostics
- [Syntax tree](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/norn-lang/norn/main/docs/ast.md): the AST and its versioned JSON form
- [Reference runtime](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/norn-lang/norn/main/docs/reference-runtime.md): how to run programs against the simulated host

## Optional

- [Runtime research](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/norn-lang/norn/main/docs/research/runtime.md): the durable-execution design behind the runtime
